response.description:
Microsoft Foundry now has a Developer Training
tier, offering ultra-low-cost model training by leveraging spot capacity. It’s designed to match the affordability of
Developer tier for hosting but applied to the training phase of
fine-tuning workflows.​ This tier is ideal for developers testing
multiple model variants, MVPs, and teams with low-throughput workloads,
enabling rapid experimentation and affordable iteration before scaling
production.Learn more.
response.title: Announcing: Developer Training tier for low-cost fine-tuning training
